title: Producer-step state update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine, let $C,e$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ and $r$ be Boolean words. For every natural number $t$, applying the producer step to the retained state encoding $x$, time $t$, and stored rows $r$ gives the retained state encoding $x$, time $t+1$, and the rows $r$ followed by the visit row for $M,C,e,x$ at time $t$.
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, stored rows, and time $t$, one producer step on the retained state at time $t$ yields the retained state at time $t+1$ whose rows are extended by the visit row of time $t$ in fixed work-tape order.
